CBSE Board Class 12th Supplementary Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

CBSE Board Class 12th Supplementary Admit Card 2026. Candidates can now download their admit card / hall ticket from the official website before the exam date. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Name of the Examination : CBSE Board Class 10th 12th
  • CBSE Board High School Result 2026 Declare Date : 15/04/2026
  • CBSE Board Intermediate Result 2026 Declare Date : April
  • Download Supplementary Admit Card : Click Here
  • Download Supplementary Exam Notice : Click Here
  • Download Second Board Exam Result : Click Here

Application Fee

  • CBSE Board High School Result 2026 Declare Date : 15/04/2026

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
